name: Roche aux Fées
text: La Roche aux Fées, the Fairies' Rock, is the great megalithic tomb near Essé in Brittany. The dictionary routes this headword to the Essé article, which carries the fuller record. Popular etymology ties the local name to the Gaulish god Esus.
